artDirection: Practical mountain cabins, painted horizontal timber, crisp daylight and enamel signs. Pine, glacier, cranberry, goldenrod, snow and slate. Condensed working-sign typography, not a resort or a luxury estate.
presentation: Cranberry and pine are photographs of different cabin subjects, not a recolour preview. The recovered after study is used independently, not as evidence of a completed customer project or a pixel-matched transformation.

supportingMediaSearch.result: Only the known cabin studies matched. Two Pexels material photographs supply timber-care and planning detail; neither is used by another template. No new generation.

hero.alt: A cranberry-painted timber cabin with white window trim, a dark roof and fir trees against distant mountains.

pine-cabin.alt: A different cabin seen at an angle, with pine-green timber siding, a glacier-blue door and white trim.

weathered-cabin.alt: A mountain cabin with faded grey-beige timber siding, cream trim and a gravel approach.

pine-finish.alt: Pine-green cabin siding and white trim beside a natural timber door and gravel path.
